verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's core documented capabilities directly cover routing, load balancing, health checking, and request/response transformation via plugins, with declarative/Admin API configuration and RESTful proxying — the canonical function of an API gateway. There is one minor community report of a router-cache bug on an old version (0.14.1), but this doesn't contradict the core capability at current versions. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark/case-study corroboration beyond vendor docs and GitHub README, and confirmation the old router-cache bug is fully resolved in current releases.
